groups = {
  "A": [9,5,3,4],
  "B": [2,1,3,8],
  "C": [4,5,6,7],
}
anchors = [(8,1,11,"B"),(9,3,3,"A"),(6,5,13,"C"),(1,9,7,"B"),(2,11,13,"B"),(7,13,4,"C")]
rows, cols = 15, 18
grid = [[0]*cols for _ in range(rows)]
# Original strip cells
for c,v in enumerate(groups["A"]): grid[0][c]=v
for c,v in enumerate(groups["B"]): grid[14][c]=v
for i,v in enumerate(groups["C"]): grid[14][14+i]=v
placements=[]
for color,r,c,g in anchors:
    seq=groups[g]
    idx=seq.index(color)
    start=c-idx
    cells=[]
    for i,v in enumerate(seq):
        cc=start+i
        assert 0 <= cc < cols
        assert grid[r][cc] in (0,v), (r,cc,grid[r][cc],v)
        grid[r][cc]=v
        cells.append([r,cc,v])
    placements.append({"anchor":[r,c,color],"group":g,"start_col":start,"cells":cells})
print({"placements":placements,"nonzero_rows":{str(r):[[c,v] for c,v in enumerate(row) if v] for r,row in enumerate(grid) if any(row)},"overlap_colors":{"A_B":sorted(set(groups['A'])&set(groups['B'])),"A_C":sorted(set(groups['A'])&set(groups['C'])),"B_C":sorted(set(groups['B'])&set(groups['C']))}})
